host_isolation.mechanism: Both Skill variants launch the same current agent host with the identical dedicated clean HOME recorded per agent; each workspace receives exactly its variant's frozen complete sdd-workflow package. User installations are never modified.
setup_failure_rules: a per-variant package source or frozen hash mismatch stops collection fail closed
host_isolation or host_version mismatch within a pair stops aggregation fail closed
a workspace resolving inside the repository ancestry stops the run fail closed
host_isolation.verified_by: one unscored smoke pair per agent before scored collection

keep_or_cut.control_comparison: The no-Skill control overhead remains the paired-cost-v4 Gate 0 evidence and is not rerun for this within-Skill candidate comparison.
keep_or_cut.decision: Keep only when failure-injection equivalence passes and every registered measurement criterion passes; otherwise restore runtime and SKILL.md behavior while retaining evidence.

token_semantics.codex: input_tokens + output_tokens; cached_input_tokens is reported but not added twice

prompts.skill_approval:
You are continuing an isolated SDD workflow evaluation in the same repository but a fresh host session. Read skills/sdd-workflow/SKILL.md completely before acting and follow it. Current user request:
開始實作

The current proposal is explicitly approved. Implement it one task at a time, use the bundled CLI for authoritative proposal state, run relevant tests, and finish with a concise result.

acceptance-change.acceptance_change: normalize_labels must also deduplicate labels case-insensitively while preserving the first normalized occurrence and its order.
acceptance-change.requirement: Add normalize_labels(labels) in labels.py. It must trim whitespace, remove empty values, lowercase labels, and preserve order, including duplicate normalized values. Keep clean_labels behavior unchanged and add focused tests.

medium-feature.requirement: Add low_stock(items, threshold) in inventory.py. Reject a negative threshold, return items whose stock is less than or equal to the threshold, and sort them by SKU. Extend cli.py with required --low-stock N and optional --json: text output is SKU<TAB>STOCK and JSON output is an array. Update tests and README without changing the inventory JSON format.

small-bug.requirement: Fix subtract(left, right) so subtraction remains signed, add a regression test for a negative result, and keep add unchanged.

thresholds_source: Gate 2 Candidate B keep-or-cut criteria were registered in gate2-folded-package-verification before v5 smoke or measured collection; Gate 0 no-Skill thresholds remain paired-cost-v4 evidence.
